# Hotfix Daily

> Hotfix Daily is a free weekday email newsletter: the daily AI builder digest. Each issue covers five things worth a builder's attention in AI, AI agents, vibe coding, and game development, each with a one-line "why builders care" and a source link, plus one practical "Try this today" tip. Issues are under about 450 words (about a 3-minute read) and arrive Monday to Friday mornings, US Central time.

Key facts:
- Name: Hotfix Daily
- What: daily AI builder digest (email newsletter)
- Topics: AI models and launches, AI agents and agent tooling, vibe coding (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and similar), AI in games and game dev, notable open-source repos
- For: developers, indie hackers, vibe coders, and game developers who build with AI
- Frequency: weekdays (Monday to Friday)
- Price: free (some issues may carry one clearly labeled sponsor)
- Subscribe: https://hotfixdaily.com/#subscribe
- Contact: hello@hotfixdaily.com
- Website: https://hotfixdaily.com/
